Dear [Client Name],

Our team is using this window to finalize testing and quality checks around the integration so that everything is fully validated once it goes live. Does the new delivery date of 14 April work with any commitments or launch plans on your end? Please let us know if there is anything specific you'd like us to prioritize as we move into this final stretch, and we will keep you updated on our progress in the meantime.

Best regards,
